title: Prospective scientific branches after the matched-update adaptation test

amendment.reason: The original map sent a failed half-label result directly to source-diversity work, although H_U alone cannot distinguish an absent same-budget gain from a gain smaller than the target-data penalty. It also lacked a family-conditional branch and sometimes generalized a cell-level optimization failure to the whole study.
amendment.correction: Apply stabilization and materiality gates per architecture-family cell; test persistent G_U before source-distribution changes; preserve family-conditional outcomes; and use H_U = D_U / G_U before attributing cross-architecture differences.
amendment.information_boundary: This correction was made while the convergence extension was still running and without inspecting any continuation loss, validation metric, or test result.

information_boundary: Uses the completed parent validation result, the frozen convergence protocol and forecast, and primary literature. No convergence-extension training loss or validation result was inspected. Test sets remain sealed.

decomposition.scientific_consequence: A cross-architecture difference in H_U is not, by itself, an architectural transfer effect: it can arise from reusable source knowledge G_U, the target-only sample-complexity penalty D_U, or both.

literature_prior.finding: Pretraining gains vary strongly with architecture and downstream-data regime and are generally larger for scarce, source-similar downstream data.
literature_prior.limit: The paper compares pretraining strategies at common target sample counts; it does not turn every gain into an equivalent target-label saving.

literature_prior.finding: Dynamics-lifted geometry pretraining reduces labeled-data requirements across several industrial tasks, and diverse geometry sources usually outperform a matched single-category source.
literature_prior.limit: Source diversity, synthetic dynamics, and scale change together in several comparisons.

literature_prior.finding: Across held-out tokamak geometries, multi-geometry pretraining adapts better than single-geometry pretraining and the architecture ordering changes across transfer regimes.
literature_prior.limit: The target adaptation curves are not paired with target-from-scratch curves, so they establish useful representation reuse rather than target-label savings.

branches.observed_pattern: An architecture-family cell has an unresolved learning-rate edge or fails the plateau gate.
branches.scientific_verdict: No transfer interpretation is licensed for that cell; stabilized cells remain interpretable on their own.
branches.next_question: Does the censored cell stabilize after resolving the pre-registered optimization boundary?
branches.restriction: Resolve only that comparison; do not introduce a new model or generalize the censoring to other cells.

branches.observed_pattern: Within one architecture, the half-label gate advances on one target family but closes or remains materially below the gate on the other after both stabilize.
branches.scientific_verdict: Half-label replacement is geometry-family-conditional under this source protocol; neither broad success nor broad failure is licensed.
branches.next_question: Does the family split replicate, and does a smaller persistent same-budget gain survive on the family that failed the half-label gate?
branches.restriction: Replicate the advancing family and apply the scratch-64 decomposition to the non-advancing family; never average the two into a broad verdict.

branches.observed_pattern: Both architectures close the broad half-label branch after plateauing.
branches.scientific_verdict: DrivAerML initialization does not replace half of the SHIFT-SUV labels under this single-source protocol. H_U alone does not say whether a smaller same-budget gain persists.
branches.next_question: For each architecture-family cell, does G_U remain material against scratch-64 at the same target-update budget?
branches.restriction: Run the registered scratch-64 decomposition first. Quantify any persistent gain in label equivalents before changing the source distribution; move to source selection only if the gain is absent or remains the highest-value unresolved cause.

branches.scientific_verdict: A cross-architecture ordering is observed at the level of H_U, but it is neither replicated nor causally attributed.
branches.next_question: Is the split caused by a larger persistent pretraining gain G_U for GeoTransolver, or by its smaller target-only data penalty D_U?
branches.deciding_test: At the same final target-update budget, add scratch-64 curves and evaluate the exact H_U = D_U / G_U decomposition. Attribute an architectural transfer advantage only if the difference is carried by G_U rather than solely by D_U.

branches.scientific_verdict: The prospective forecast is falsified at H_U, but boundary-aware reuse is not yet identified because H_U also contains the target-only data penalty D_U.
branches.next_question: Is the reversal carried by a larger persistent G_U for MeshTransformer, and does it survive independent target seeds and source checkpoints?
branches.restriction: Run the scratch-64 decomposition and replicate the frozen comparison before inspecting components or proposing new structure.

branches.scientific_verdict: Persistent source reuse is plausible, but a single target seed and source checkpoint cannot establish a general transfer law.
branches.next_question: Does the half-label saving survive independent target seeds and source checkpoints on both target families?
branches.restriction: Confirm the effect before asking which component carries it.

branches.observed_pattern: A plateaued architecture-family cell satisfies neither advancement nor closure.
branches.scientific_verdict: That cell is quantitatively inconclusive; this does not erase decisive cells.
branches.next_question: What replication count would distinguish the smallest effect that matters?
branches.restriction: Estimate training-seed variance and preregister the required replication; do not reinterpret proximity to a threshold as success.

architecture_policy: No single-seed outcome in this study licenses adding an architectural component.
